You spread your hands. The world answers with a deep vibration, and a towering knot of elemental force takes form.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One visible unoccupied placement within 3 squares that fits the chosen form's entire footprint.
Type
Magic / Summoning

Choose one Elemental entry from the summon selection with a minimum tier of 7 or lower. Call one instance using its summon profile. Choose the form anew each casting. It remains for one scene.
